test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All cloths are green.

2. All green are leaves.

3. Some leaves are originals.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some originals are green.

II. Some leaves are cloths.

III. No cloth is an original.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
